newsitem.title: USA: Ford Motor unit to issue $1.0 bln global issue.
newsitem.headline: Ford Motor unit to issue $1.0 bln global issue.

text.p: Ford Motor Co unit, Ford Motor Credit Corp, is expected to tap the corporate bond market with a $1.0 billion global debt offering, dealers said on Monday.
The A1/A-plus rated deal is expected to include a 10-year maturity and will be underewritten by Morgan Stanley & Co, dealers said.
Unofficial price talk on the issue is seen in the low 60 basis points over U.S. Treasuries arena, they said.
Ford Motor Credit Corp is the financing arm of Ford Motor Co, the world's second largest automobile manufacturer, which is based in Dearborn, Michigan.
